channel.title: Liquid Cooling Guide — Industry Radar
channel.description: Liquid cooling news and milestones: technology, products, investment, standards. Every item sourced.

item.title: Singapore publishes SS 726:2026 — first national standard for liquid cooling in tropical climates
item.description: Source: Singapore Standards / this site's standards tracker — Covers direct-to-chip in tropical data centers; excludes standalone edge cabinets — scope matters when vendors claim compliance.

item.title: 3M completes its exit from PFAS manufacturing, ending fluorinated coolant production
item.description: Source: 3M News Center — Announced Dec 2022, completed end-2025. Single-fluid-class dependence is now a procurement risk — PG25 water-glycol is the default survivor.

item.title: OCP ORv3 blind-mate liquid cooling manifold spec reaches Rev 1.0
item.description: Source: Open Compute Project — Servers that mate on insertion, interoperable across vendors — the lock-in defense checklist item in our RFQ tool.

item.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 mainstreams 120 kW liquid-cooled racks
item.description: Source: NVIDIA — Announced at GTC 2024: rack-scale liquid cooling left the exotic category. The power cliff behind this guide's existence.

item.title: 3M announces exit from all PFAS manufacturing by end of 2025
item.description: Source: 3M News Center — The announcement that redirected immersion-cooling fluid roadmaps for the entire industry.

item.title: STULZ × CoolIT ship the first turnkey liquid-cooled micro data center
item.description: Source: STULZ product page (verified in our comparison data) — Still the only full predecessor in the 20-50 kW turnkey cabinet space — see the gap statement in our cabinet comparison.
